# 08-analyses

System FMEA, fault trees per safety function, common cause failure analysis, STPA, independence of the safety layer from the tele-operation stack and the locomotion policy.

Standard clauses: ISO 13849-1 §6 and Annex F, IEC 60812, IEC 61025, STPA Handbook, IEC 61508-3 Annex F, IEC 62443-3-3.

## Work products

| ID | Work product | Gate | Status |

| [WP-A-02](WP-A-02-fault-tree-analysis.md) | Fault tree analysis, one tree per safety function | G2 | Skeleton |
| [WP-A-03](WP-A-03-common-cause-failure-analysis.md) | Common cause failure analysis | G2 | Skeleton |
| [WP-A-04](WP-A-04-stpa.md) | System-theoretic process analysis (STPA) of the motion control chain (tele-operation, policy, MCB, actuators) | G2 | Skeleton |
| [WP-A-05](WP-A-05-independence-of-the-safety-chain.md) | Independence of the safety chain from the policy and tele-operation stack (freedom from interference) | G2 | Skeleton |
